findings.comment: Dumpster or refuse collection area location is not shown on site plan with required dimensions. Master Comment Report TPW-25 (Pending) indicates city requires identification of trash collection point and confirmation of collection method, but applicant response is pending. Site plan does not demonstrate collection vehicle maneuvering is contained on-site without using public ROW.

applicableAreas: parking drive aisles and pedestrian corridors
findings.comment: Trash pickup and delivery location not demonstrated to avoid intermixing with concurrent site operations. Site plan does not show collection point location, making verification impossible that trash collection facility is located off main access or parking aisles and away from all pedestrian corridors as required by TCM 9.4.1.C.

Multi-Family Recycling Plan Form completion and submission status cannot be verified. No completed form is present in available submittals. Sheet 1 includes mandatory note that compliance with Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance is required, but evidence of property owner completing and submitting the form to Solid Waste Services is not provided.
Recycling Plan Form submission to Solid Waste Services within 14 days after occupancy cannot be verified. No evidence of submission exists in available records, and occupancy has not yet occurred.

On-site storage space for recycling containers is not shown on site plan. No designated recycling storage area is labeled or depicted on the site plan drawings, making compliance verification impossible.

Dumpster enclosure adequacy cannot be verified. Site plan does not show enclosure dimensions or demonstrate that both trash and recycling containers can fit simultaneously within the screened dumpster pad. Master Comment Report TPW-26 indicates roll-out bins may be proposed rather than a fixed dumpster, but the plan does not clarify which method is being used or provide dimensions.

Recycling equipment location is not shown on site plan when recycling facilities are required outside the building. No exterior recycling storage area or equipment location is depicted or labeled on the site plan.

applicableAreas: entire site - adjacent to SF-3 property
findings.comment: Compliance with 20-foot setback for dumpster or permanently placed refuse receptacle from adjacent SF-3 residential property cannot be verified because no dumpster or refuse receptacle location is shown on site plan. No setback dimensions are provided.

Site plan does not include the required Compatibility section note: 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive.' This note is a standard Austin site plan submittal requirement per General Site Plan Notes (Compatibility section).

Refuse collection area screening from adjacent residential properties cannot be verified because no trash collection area is depicted on site plan. Dimensions from trash facility to nearest residential property are not shown, making screening compliance unverifiable.

codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes (Fire Department section)
findings.comment: Compliance with Fire Department note requiring commercial dumpster or container ≥1.5 CY clearance cannot be verified. No dumpster location is shown on site plan, and confirmation that the required Fire Department standard note is included in plan notes is not evident.

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report - TPW-25 and TPW-27

findings.comment: Garbage collection vehicle maneuvering containment on-site cannot be verified. Site plan does not show collection point location, and Master Comment Report TPW-25 remains pending regarding collection methodology. TPW-27 also remains pending receipt of trash service commitment letter confirming minimum clearance and maneuverability requirements.
